dog.description_text:
Meet Finn, the happiest little fella with the biggest puppy eyes in the world! This sweet, affectionate boy loves everyone he meets and is happiest just being by your side. He's wonderfully adaptable and happy to match your energy, whether that means snoozing and cuddling on the couch all day or tagging along on your next adventure. Finn is potty trained, walks well on a leash, and does great with other dogs and humans in the home. He's a sweet, food-motivated boy who genuinely wants to please. He's still working on crate training and building confidence when passing other dogs while on leash, but he's making progress. With his loving personality, easygoing nature, and endless puppy-dog eyes, Finn would make a wonderful addition to just about any home!

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it’s a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
dog.name: Finnick (Finn)
